testSuite.details: 35 tests passed with `source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest -v`; smoke `python -m pytest` also passed with 35 tests.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Есть понятная Python project structure внутри app/, соответствующая архитектуре из docs/03_architecture.md.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/ contains separate bot, services, sheets, storage, scheduler, reports, and speech packages; Task 7 code audit passed module-boundary review.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Конфигурация загружается из environment / .env и поддерживает отдельные переменные для MAIN/ERROR/NOTIFICATION bot tokens.
В strict/runtime режиме отсутствие любого из трёх bot token считается ошибкой конфигурации.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_config.py::test_strict_mode_requires_all_three_bot_tokens parametrizes all three token env vars.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Секреты не захардкожены и не выводятся в логи.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: No production secrets in .env.example; .gitignore excludes .env and credential files; tests/test_config.py::test_secret_values_are_redacted and ::test_logging_setup_uses_redacted_metadata pass; security audit passed.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: SQLite technical schema создаётся или валидируется локальной командой.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/storage/sqlite.py initialize_schema; tests/test_sqlite_schema.py all pass against temporary DBs.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: SQLite используется только для technical state, drafts, scheduler state, reminder log, technical errors; бизнес-факты не моделируются как primary storage.
SQLite schema продумана как физическая technical-state БД: есть draft owner, ключи, индексы и ограничения для idempotency.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: draft_sessions owner table, constraints/indexes in app/storage/sqlite.py; tests cover draft owner, scheduler/reminder idempotency, indexes.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Google Sheets integration оформлен как отдельный boundary; production credentials не нужны для unit tests.
Notification routing boundary различает main bot, error bot и notification bot.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/bot/clients.py BotPurpose; app/services/notifications.py NotificationRouter; boundary tests cover distinct bots and technical error routing.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Scheduler foundation использует Asia/Yekaterinburg, дату окончания 2026-07-31, 8 недель + 4 дня итогов и расписание из product decisions.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/scheduler/calendar.py constants; tests/test_scheduler_foundation.py covers timezone, end date, final summary window, reminder times.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: File storage paths и retention constants отражают решения по audio/PDF/backups.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/storage/paths.py StoragePathPolicy and retention constants; tests/test_storage_paths.py.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: В проекте есть тестовая база: unit tests обязательны, integration tests покрывают SQLite schema/config/scheduler foundation.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: pytest suite has 35 tests across config, SQLite temporary DB schema checks, scheduler constants, storage paths, boundaries, and tooling; test audit passed.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Нет Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Kubernetes или иной out-of-MVP инфраструктуры.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: pyproject dependencies contain only pytest dev tooling; tests/test_project_tooling.py::test_forbidden_infrastructure_dependencies_absent; no live SDKs introduced.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: README/docs при необходимости обновлены только в части запуска foundation и без изменения продуктовых решений.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: README.md documents local foundation setup/test/smoke commands and explicitly states deploy/full flows are out of scope.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Локальные smoke-команды позволяют агенту проверить, что foundation запускается и тесты проходят.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: `python -m pytest`, `python -m pytest -v`, and `python -c "import app; print('ok')"` were run successfully in .venv.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Python project metadata and package imports work.
pytest test suite exists and passes.
Settings loader supports .env and required MVP env vars.
Strict/runtime settings validation requires all three Telegram bot tokens.
SQLite schema initializer creates only technical-state tables.
SQLite schema includes physical constraints for draft identity, scheduler idempotency, and reminder deduplication.
Google Sheets gateway boundary exists with fake implementation for tests.
Main/error/notification bot boundaries exist as separate concepts.
Notification routing prevents technical errors from using participant/captain/tracker/Sitnikov routes.
Scheduler constants match approved product decisions.
File-storage policy matches audio, SQLite, PDF, and backup paths.
techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_storage_paths.py covers audio, sqlite, pdf, and backup path policies.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: No Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Kubernetes, live Telegram SDK, live Google API SDK, PDF library, or speech SDK is introduced.
techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: pyproject dependencies are empty at runtime; tests/test_boundaries.py::test_boundary_modules_do_not_import_live_sdks and project tooling dependency test pass.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: README or docs contain local foundation verification commands if needed.
techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: README.md contains .venv setup, pytest, and import smoke commands.

findings.title: StoragePathPolicy root validation deferred
findings.expected: Future configurable roots should be validated as local paths.
findings.actual: Defaults are safe and fragments are validated; roots are not yet user-configurable in this foundation.
findings.reproduction: See task-8 security-audit residual risk for app/storage/paths.py line 16.
findings.resolution: Deferred to future task that wires StoragePathPolicy roots from settings.

findings.title: Standalone redact_value is intentionally weak without key context
findings.actual: redact_mapping protects settings by key; redact_value alone only catches secret-like substrings.
findings.reproduction: See task-8 security-audit residual risk for app/config.py line 147.
findings.resolution: No blocker; continue using redact_mapping for settings/log metadata.

findings.title: One smoke test is low-value
findings.expected: Smoke tests should protect setup behavior.
findings.resolution: No blocker; surrounding tests provide meaningful coverage.
